The Fed's rate is 5.00% or higher after April: a rise at every meeting, or a half-point step

The upper bound of the federal funds target range stands at 5.00% or higher after the FOMC meeting that ends April 28, 2027: four or more quarter points from today, which takes a rise at each of the four meetings or a half-point move.
